points.requirement: Autologous cells derive from the recipient; allogeneic cells derive from another donor.

evidence.supportingExcerpt: Autologous cells come from the intended recipient; allogeneic cells come from another person. This source distinction is separate from whether engineering occurs outside or inside the body and from whether a cell product or a carrier is administered. Benjamin's 2020 report combined early cohorts of seven children and fourteen adults; graft-versus-host disease, cytokine release syndrome, infections and treatment-related deaths were reported. A source or edit label does not eliminate clinical risks. These are small, uncontrolled reports, and their participant counts must not be added to later overlapping CALM analyses.
